title: Sailing and winery
text: Very unique experience! I would definitely recommend the sailing experience. The winery tour was one of the best I’ve been on and the wines were delicious.
author: Angela_B

title: great time.  Experienced...
text: great time.  Experienced Captain. Knowledge of waters and good instructions regarding safety and boarding of boat for the inexperienced sailors.  Adjusted sails when wind was picking up to keep crew feeling safe.  Snacks and beverages were a nice touch and appreciated by all.
author: Suzan_U

title: Wine and Mediterranean!
text: Great way to sail the Mediterranean! Captain was friendly and lively. Tour was short but wines were great.
author: Blanca_H

title: Perfect way to see Barcelona and a great winery!
text: Marino was truly awesome.  The winery visit was great and we got to see the entire city and then outside the city all on bike!  Great time!
author: S3780FIchrisj

title: Informative and enjoyable winery tour.
text: The sailboat ride was good, but the winery tour was great. Annette took us on a very informative tour of the vineyards and the winery. Afterwards we were given a lesson on what to look for to judge and taste wine. We received ample pours of four of their wines along with a delicious Catalonian lunch.
author: MarianneMSC

title: The best!
text: Fabulous! Amazing vineyards. Gorgeous properties. Wonderful hosts. Exquisite wines. Take this tour. We went on another wine trip and it was not nearly as good as this one.
author: nancy_L

title: Wow!! Our group was large...
text: Wow!! Our group was large and was split into two. Our group took a van to a winery outside of the city. We got a tour of the winery, 4 tastings, and some appetizers. We then took a sailboat back to the meeting spot. The sailboat included a small charcuterie board to share and....more wine!!! Our captain was great and let us try out sailing! He brought the party! You will leave feeling absolutely great!!
author: Katie_M

title: Barcelona with a Splash
text: Had a wonderful time. The group was big so they split us up. We did the vineyard first and the sailing second. Would highly recommended that agenda. The afternoon sailing was so much fun.  Bring a swim suit if you want to jump in the Mediterranean to cool off while sailing.
author: Tina_D

title: Our guide at the winery...
text: Our guide at the winery was very pleasant and we enjoyed our wine tasting and food. The captain on the boat was fun and we had a great time sailing back to Barcelona.
author: Shawn_S

title: Great experience, fun, delicious and entertaining
text: The winery was beautiful and Marc, the sommelier, was informative and entertaining. The wine tasting was very good and the food was a perfect accompaniment. The small group size was just right. The sailing trip was fun even though the weather was not cooperative. Overall, it was a great experience.
author: Anne_B
